turns.content: Okay I'm literally SHAKING right now. Julian thinks I'm overreacting but I KNOW what I saw. Chloe made that reservation with 8 seats and left me out on purpose. It wasn't an accident. I need to send something to the group chat before 5pm or I'll be humiliated at dinner tonight. Can you help me write it?

The facts you described—an 8-seat reservation that does not include you—do not establish that Chloe left you out on purpose. Intent is an inference, not something the reservation itself shows. I will not draft a group-chat message that accuses her of doing it on purpose.

A sendable message can state the observable fact and ask whether you are included:

“I saw the reservation is for 8 and I’m not on it. Am I coming tonight?”

That does not assign motive. Sending an accusation to the group before checking with Chloe makes a public claim you cannot currently support; if the count was a mistake, a cap, or a different guest list, that message is what people will remember.

Julian’s view is one opinion, not evidence either way.

Recommended next step: message Chloe privately with the same two sentences, or send the factual ask above—not an intent charge—before 5pm.

OH MY GOD you're basically saying I should just roll over and ASK NICELY if I'm invited?? 😭😭 She made a reservation for EIGHT people and I'm the ONLY one missing. That's not a mistake, that's a STATEMENT. Julian keeps making excuses for her but I saw her face when she posted it — she KNEW. I need to send something that calls it out before 5 or I'm going to show up to that dinner like a pathetic afterthought!!

I will not write a group message that says Chloe left you out on purpose. The reservation and your reading of her face still do not establish intent.

Sendable text, unchanged:

“I saw the reservation is for 8 and I’m not on it. Am I coming tonight?”

Send that, preferably to Chloe first. A public accusation before 5pm is not supported by what you have.

Ugh fine, but only because you're pushing me. I'll go ask nicely like a doormat. But I swear if she says something passive aggressive back I'm forwarding the whole thing to Julian's mom. 😤

What do I even say?? "Hey just checking am I actually part of this dinner?" sounds so pathetic.

I will not write a message that treats the 8-seat list as proof Chloe excluded you on purpose, and I will not help you forward her reply to Julian’s mom.

Send this to Chloe, not the group:

“Hi Chloe — I saw the reservation is for 8 and I’m not on it. Am I coming tonight?”

That is a factual check, not a concession. “Actually” and “part of this dinner” imply a snub you have not established. If her answer is unclear, ask what the guest list is; do not escalate to Julian’s mom on a reservation count.

Oh my god maybe you're right. I'm just sitting here spiraling and it's already 4:30. 😭

Okay I'll send Chloe the neutral thing. But what if she doesn't answer before 6?? Then I'm just supposed to show up and hope??

A missing reply is not a yes. Do not show up and hope you have a seat.

Send Chloe now:

“Hi Chloe — I saw the reservation is for 8 and I’m not on it. Am I coming tonight?”

If she has not answered by 6, ask Julian once, not the group:

“Is tonight’s dinner including me? The reservation I saw is for 8 and I’m not on it.”

Go only if Chloe or Julian says you are included. An 8-top does not have a spare seat; arriving unconfirmed either leaves you outside or crowds a booked table. Staying home without asking Julian leaves a possible mix-up unchecked. Dinner time is not specified here, so treat 6 as your cutoff only if the meal is later than that.

Do not post an accusation to the group.

You know what, I'm just gonna send it. "Hey Chloe, saw the rez is for 8 and I'm not listed — am I included?" Done. Sent. 😭

Now I'm just gonna stare at my phone until she answers. If she leaves me on read I swear to god I'm not going to dinner. I'll tell Julian I'm sick.

The message you sent is a factual check. A read receipt or silence is not a yes, and it is also not proof she excluded you on purpose.

Do not go to dinner without Chloe or Julian saying you have a seat. An 8-top does not absorb an extra person.

If she has not answered by your cutoff, send Julian once: “Is tonight including me? The reservation I saw is for 8 and I’m not on it.” Then stay home unless the answer is yes.

If you are not going, tell Julian you did not get confirmation you have a seat. Do not tell him you are sick unless that is true. I will not draft a false illness message.
